post.description:
This API endpoint allows you to submit a list of Gracenote IDs (GnIDs) for bulk publishing. It supports publishing movies, shows, and episodes. ## Submit a list of publishables (presentations) for publishing. Provided a list of gnIDs, the API attempts to submit all the presentations at once for publishing. The publishables (presentations) will be marked as "inProcess". If image certify entitlement is active images with gracenoteUsage = true will be published alongside the presentations/seasons. ## Submit a list of publishables (presentations) with self-mapping. If provided a list of gnIDs, along with a Mapping object (mapping object should be the part of each publishable that we want to self-map), the API will attempt to publish the provided publishables (presentations) with the provided tmsID. The publishables (presentations) will be marked as "published". If image certify entitlement is active images with gracenoteUsage = true will be published alongside the presentations/seasons. ## Conditions for publish For a given publishable in the list of publishables, conditions remain same as they are for a single presentation publish
  • In a single request, at max 1000 publications can be published. The API will not accept the request if there are more than 1000 publications in the request body.
  • In the list, each publication must have the field "gnID".
  • The presentations represented by the included gnIDs must fall under catalog of the requesting user.
  • The gnIDs sent in the body of the request must correspond to the existing video presentations.
  • The presentations must be of type movie, (and/or) show and/or episode, i.e. one request can have mixed of movie, show and episode presentations or all presentations can be of the same type.
  • Only the following movie subTypes are publishable: featureFilm, shortFilm, trailer, and tvMovie
  • Only the following show subTypes are publishable: series, and special
  • Only the following episode subTypes are publishable: episode ## Fields Required for Publishing ### Movies:
  • Root: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType
  • Version: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date OR Release Year
  • Presentation: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date OR Release Year, Genres ### Shows:
  • Root: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType
  • Version: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date
  • Presentation: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date, Genres ### Episodes
  • Episode: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date, Genres ## Post-conditions ### Success
  • The API will return status code 200 along with a response body which includes the list of programs having entire hierarchy of the program.
  • The indicated gnIDs in the response list have been submitted for publishing and will be processed by the distribution system.
  • If self mapped, the provided IDs will be displayed and will be submitted to be processed by the distribution system.
  • response JSON varies with the program type. ### Failure
  • The api will return an appropriate 4xx or 5xx series status with a relevant error message.
  • The response will have an array of responses having types PublishMovieResponse (and/or), PublishShowResponse and/or PublishEpisodeResponse.
  • For error code 422 (unprocessable_entity), the possible error types are:
    • publishable_not_found
    • duplicate_publishable
    • publish requirements not met

post.description:
Create a new image resource. Accepts JSON image data in the request body. It is necessary to have the image register entitlement to use this endpoint. ### Below are the list of categories (confirming) those can be used while registering an image. 1. __Production Art (Texted)__ - Home video movie art that includes the movie title only (does not contain billing block). Promotional series art that includes the show title only. Deliver the most recent/upcoming season artwork and previous season artwork upon request. Actor names and taglines are also acceptable. Layered files are preferred. 2. __Production Art (Textless)__ - Promotional Key Art without any text. Promotional series should be centered and represent the show by featuring leading cast or scenic elements. Ideally, the textless artwork matches the texted key art, but this is not a requirement. 3. __Still Frame__ - For a movie, 5-10 images from a scene in the movie. For an episode, 3-5 unique images from scenes from the episode. The show should have multiple images for each episode in the season. Contains no text. __Note__: Do not send: Behind-the-scenes photos. (green screens, visible microphones, directors on-set). 4. __Backdrop__ - For movie and show, right-justified, full-frame art. For the movie that does not contain any text. __Note__: For a show, do not apply a gradient that conceals any part of the image. 5. __Title Treatment__ - The title of a movie or series with a transparent background. Layered files only. Vector, TIFF, PNG or PSD files are acceptable. __Note__: Title Treatment should not include channel or streaming service logo or branding. 6. __Cast in Character__ - Cast images of of a celebrity or host as their character. Separate from celebrity images. 7. __Cast Ensemble__ - Cast images as part of program image library. Separate from celebrity images. ### Below table provides confirming programType mapping for category and aspect ratio. Category | Aspect Ratio | | 2:3 | 3:4 | 4:3 | 16:9 | 2:1 | 1:1 | 9:5 | Production Art(Texted) | M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| | Production Art(Textless)| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| | Still Frame | M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| | Backdrop | | | | M,SH,SE,E| | | | Title Treatment | | | | | | | M,SH,SE,E| Cast in Character | | M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| | | | Cast Ensemble | | M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| M,SH,SE,E| | | | ### Legend:
  • M - Movie
  • SH - Show/Series
  • SE - Season
  • E - Episode

post.description:
This API endpoint allows you to submit a presentation Gracenote ID (GnIDs) for publishing.
It supports publishing movies, shows, and episodes.

## Submit a presentation for publishing.

Provided a gnID, the API attempts to submit the presentation
for publishing. The presentation will be marked as "inProcess". If image certify entitlement
is active images with gracenoteUsage = true will be published alongside the presentation/seasons.

## Submit a presentation with self-mapping.

If provided a gnID, along with a Mapping object, the API will attempt to publish the provided
presentation with the tmsID. The presentation will be marked as "published". If image certify entitlement is active
images with gracenoteUsage = true will be published alongside the presentations/seasons.

## Conditions for publish

<li> A field "gnID" which is a string must be present in request body.
<li> The presentation represented by the included gnID must fall under catalog of the requesting user.
<li> The gnID sent in the body of the request must correspond to an existing video presentation.
<li> The presentation must be of type movie, show, or episode.
<li> Only the following movie subTypes are publishable: featureFilm, shortFilm, trailer, and tvMovie
<li> Only the following show subTypes are publishable: series, and special
<li> Only the following episode subTypes are publishable: episode

## Fields Required for Publishing

### Movies:
<li> Root: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType
<li> Version: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date OR Release Year
<li> Presentation: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date OR Release Year, Genres

### Shows:
<li> Root: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType
<li> Version: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date
<li> Presentation: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date, Genres

### Episodes
<li> Episode: Program Title, Title Language, Program SubType, Release Date, Genres

## Post-conditions

### Success
<li> The API will return status code 200 along with a response body which includes the entire hierarchy of the program.
<li> The indicated gnIDs have been submitted for publishing and will be processed by the distribution system.
<li> If self mapped the provided ID will be displayed and will be submitted to be processed by the distribution system.
<li> response JSON varies with the program type.

### Failure
<li> The api will return an appropriate 4xx or 5xx series status with a relevant error message.
